name: Shanghai Maritime University
tuition_info:
Undergraduate: 20,000 RMB/year
Master's: 23,000 RMB/year
Doctoral: 29,000 RMB/year
Application fee: 400 RMB

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – High-Level Graduate Program
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance for the approved duration of study.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with strong academic record. Master's applicants need a bachelor's degree or above and be under 35; doctoral applicants need a master's degree or above.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via SMU portal at gjy.shmtu.edu.cn and also via the CSC system at studyinchina.csc.edu.cn before February 1, 2026. SMU reviews materials and interviews candidates then nominates to CSC for final review.

scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship Type A (Full Scholarship)
scholarships.amount_text: Type A covers tuition, free on-campus dormitory, living allowance (undergraduate 2,500 RMB/month; master 3,000 RMB/month; doctoral 3,500 RMB/month) and medical insurance 800 RMB/year.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with outstanding academic performance. Undergraduate under 25 with high school diploma; master under 35 with bachelor's degree; doctoral under 40 with master's degree. Must not hold other Chinese government scholarships.
scholarships.instructions: Complete the Shanghai Government Scholarship form and upload it via SMU international student portal before April 30, 2026. SMU conducts annual review for renewal.

scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship Type B (Partial Scholarship)
scholarships.amount_text: Type B covers tuition exemption and comprehensive medical insurance for the approved duration of study.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent non-Chinese citizens applying for undergraduate, master's or doctoral degree programs at SMU who are not receiving other Chinese government scholarships.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the signed SGS form through SMU online portal before April 30, 2026. See the degree program guide for detailed requirements.

name: SISU
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – High-Level Postgraduate Program
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with excellent academic record. Master's applicants need a bachelor's degree; doctoral applicants need a master's degree. Must meet SISU language and admission requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSC system and SISU Office of International Student Affairs portal. SISU reviews materials and nominates candidates to CSC for final approval.

scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.amount_text: Type A covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and medical insurance; Type B covers tuition and medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding non-Chinese citizens applying for degree programs at SISU with good academic performance and conduct who are not holding other Chinese government scholarships.
scholarships.instructions: Submit scholarship form together with degree application via SISU international student system. Annual review is required for renewal.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens interested in Chinese language teaching, in good health with good academic record. Must meet HSK and HSKK levels for the applied category and be recommended by a recommending institution.
scholarships.instructions: Apply online via the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship website with SISU as first choice, and confirm with SISU after winning.

name: Sun Yat-sen University
tuition_info:
Undergraduate 2026: Humanities 26,000 RMB/year; Science, Engineering and Agriculture 33,800 RMB/year; Medical 48,000 RMB/year
Master's 2026: Humanities 30,000 RMB/year; Science and Engineering 39,000 RMB/year; Medical 55,000 RMB/year; IMBA 109,000 RMB/year
Doctoral 2026: Humanities 34,000 RMB/year; Science and Engineering 44,200 RMB/year; Medical 65,000 RMB/year

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Bilateral Program (Type A)
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition fees, accommodation, living expenses and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for bachelor's, master's or doctoral study at SYSU. Applicants apply via dispatching authorities in home country and meet SYSU admission requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply to the dispatching authority in home country for recommendation, complete CSC system application with SYSU as target, and register in SYSU application system to obtain invitation letter if needed.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – High-Level Graduate Program (Type B)
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition fees, accommodation, living expenses and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding non-Chinese graduates applying for master's or doctoral programs at SYSU, in good health and meeting language and academic requirements. Agency number 10558.
scholarships.instructions: Register in both the CSC system (agency 10558, Type B) and SYSU application system, submit materials as required and await expert review.

scholarships.title: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: One-time grant: undergraduate 10,000 RMB per student; master's 20,000 RMB per student; doctoral 30,000 RMB per student.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted self-funded international students who have registered at SYSU, selected by comprehensive evaluation of academic performance.
scholarships.instructions: SYSU selects outstanding newly admitted non-government scholarship students after registration and recommends them to Guangdong Education Department for approval.

scholarships.title: Sun Yat-sen University Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to SYSU degree programs with strong academic record and good conduct who meet admission requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via SYSU international student application system and select the SYSU Scholarship program. Follow the scholarship guidelines for review.

name: SCUT
tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-medium: Liberal Arts 18,200 RMB/year; Economics and Administration 20,000 RMB/year; Science and Technology 23,000 RMB/year; Arts and Design 28,000 RMB/year
Master's: Arts 23,000 RMB/year; Business 25,000 RMB/year; Science and Technology 28,000 RMB/year; English-medium 32,000 RMB/year; MBA 44,500 RMB/year
Doctoral: Economics and Administration 34,000 RMB/year; Science and Technology 40,000 RMB/year

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance for full-time master's and doctoral study.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for full-time master's or doctoral degrees at SCUT with excellent academic background and meeting language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSC system and SCUT School of International Education portal. SCUT reviews and nominates candidates to CSC.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance for eligible Chinese language teachers and students.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens interested in Chinese language education, in good health with good academic record, meeting HSK/HSKK requirements and recommended by a recommending institution.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the scholarship website with SCUT as host, and track progress online. Confirm with SCUT after admission.

scholarships.title: Guangdong Provincial Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Exceptional full-time international degree students in Guangdong universities with excellent academic performance and good conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply after admission via SCUT international office. SCUT evaluates candidates and submits nominees to Guangdong Education Department for approval.

scholarships.title: SCUT International Student Scholarship for Excellence
scholarships.amount_text: Comprehensive or partial tuition waiver for the standard duration of the program, based on academic track record.
scholarships.eligibility: Exceptional international students enrolling as full-time degree students at SCUT with exemplary academic record.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via SCUT online application system at scut.edu.cn/apply. Scholarship level is decided by academic review.

name: Jinan University
tuition_info:
Sino-International MBA: 39,000 RMB/year (78,000 RMB for two-year program)
Other undergraduate and graduate tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Full scholarship covers tuition waiver, free dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend and comprehensive medical insurance; partial covers one or some items.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for degree study at Jinan University with good academic record. Graduate and non-degree students may register for Chinese or English-taught programs if applicable.
scholarships.instructions: Find programs via campuschina.org, apply via CSC system and JNU admission portal. Individual application is followed by college and university selection then CSC reconfirmation.

scholarships.title: Guangdong Government Outstanding Foreign Student Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: 10,000 RMB per year for undergraduates.
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time undergraduate students with foreign nationality and valid passport and visa, under 40, who passed all compulsory courses with no disciplinary records and hold no other scholarship in the year. Freshmen are not included.
documents: Application Form for Guangdong Government Outstanding Foreign Student Scholarship
scholarships.instructions: Apply each October via college selection then university selection and public list, with final approval by Guangdong Education and Finance Departments.

scholarships.title: Jinan University Silk Road Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: 15,000-30,000 RMB per year for outstanding overseas Chinese and international middle-school students; first-grade winners renewable up to four years.
scholarships.eligibility: Overseas Chinese and international students with excellent prior academic performance applying to JNU.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via JNU admission portal. Selection is based on academic excellence and comprehensive evaluation.

name: SCNU
tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Humanities and Social Science 21,000 RMB/year; Science and Engineering 22,000 RMB/year; Music and Fine Arts 24,000 RMB/year
Master's: Liberal Arts and Social Science 29,000 RMB/year; Science and Engineering 30,000 RMB/year; Music and Fine Arts 30,000 RMB/year
Doctoral International Chinese Language Education: 34,000 RMB/year
Registration fee 420 RMB; Insurance 800-1,200 RMB/year

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition fees, free dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend (undergraduates 2,500 RMB/month; master's 3,000 RMB/month; doctoral 3,500 RMB/month) and medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with excellent academics. Undergraduate under 25; master's under 35 with HSK 4 for Chinese-taught; doctoral under 40. Must meet SCNU admission requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Learn about designated universities via campuschina.org, obtain SCNU admission documents, get recommendation from receiving agency, then submit CSC online application.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens friendly to China, in good health with good academic standing, interested in Chinese language education. Must meet HSK/HSKK levels: bachelor's HSK 4 210 + HSKK 60; master's HSK 5 210 + HSKK 60; doctoral HSK 6 200 + HSKK advanced 60.
scholarships.instructions: Register on the scholarship website from February, choose SCNU as first choice, submit materials online and confirm with SCNU after winning.

scholarships.title: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: One-time grant: doctoral 30,000 RMB per person; master's 20,000 RMB per person; bachelor's 10,000 RMB per person.
scholarships.eligibility: Self-funded international students admitted by SCNU with excellent prior study and well-prepared study plan who have paid tuition and hold no other scholarship.
scholarships.instructions: Register at istudy.scnu.edu.cn, submit application and pay 420 RMB fee. SCNU experts screen candidates and submit nominees to Guangdong Education Department.

name: GDUT
tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught: Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences 18,000 RMB/year; Fine Arts 26,000 RMB/year; Sciences and Engineering 21,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught: 23,000 RMB/year
Master's: Humanities 21,000 RMB/year; Fine Arts 30,000 RMB/year; Sciences and Engineering 25,000 RMB/year
Doctoral: Humanities 28,000 RMB/year; Fine Arts 34,000 RMB/year; Sciences and Engineering 32,000 RMB/year

scholarships.title: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Bachelor 10,000 RMB/person; Master 20,000 RMB/person; Doctoral 30,000 RMB/person, for both current and new degree students.
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time international degree students at GDUT with valid passport who are friendly to China. Current students under 40 with good conduct and passed subjects; new bachelor's under 30, master's under 35, doctoral under 40. Must not hold other Chinese scholarships.
documents: Study and research plan over 1000 words for new postgraduates
scholarships.instructions: Submit paper and electronic versions to International Student Affairs Office and admission@gdut.edu.cn from May 1 to June 30. GDUT committee evaluates then Guangdong Education Department approves.

scholarships.title: GDUT Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.eligibility: New degree applicants with outstanding academic achievements, leadership and special talents applying to GDUT.
scholarships.instructions: Visit iec.gdut.edu.cn for updated notice, apply via apply.gdut.edu.cn and submit documents to admission@gdut.edu.cn.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with excellent academics applying for GDUT degree programs who meet language and admission requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via CSC system and GDUT portal at apply.gdut.edu.cn. GDUT reviews and recommends candidates to CSC.

name: GMU
tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-medium: 20,000 RMB/year
Master research-type: Chinese-medium 27,000 RMB/year; English-medium 33,000 RMB/year
Doctoral research-type: Chinese-medium 32,000 RMB/year; English-medium 38,000 RMB/year
Registration fee 500 RMB; Accommodation about 6,000 RMB/year for double room

scholarships.title: GDMU Freshmen Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.amount_text: Postgraduate 20,000 RMB and PhD 30,000 RMB for 100% of eligible freshmen with GPA 2.5 or above or average score 70 or above.
scholarships.eligibility: New international postgraduate and PhD entrants to Guangdong Medical University with GPA 2.5 or average 70+ in previous education and meeting admission requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply for admission via GDMU international office at international@gdmu.edu.cn. Eligible freshmen are considered for the scholarship on enrollment.

scholarships.title: GDMU Postgraduate Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled outstanding international postgraduate students at GDMU with good academic performance and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via GDMU international office after enrollment. Selection is based on academic and comprehensive performance.

scholarships.title: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students studying at GDMU with good academic performance and conduct who are self-funded and hold no other government scholarship.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via GDMU international office. GDMU selects candidates and Guangdong Education Department approves final list.

name: Nanjing University
tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Liberal Arts 19,000 RMB/year; Science and Business 23,000 RMB/year; Software Institute 30,000 RMB/year; Medical School 40,000 RMB/year
Graduate tuition varies by school; see the official admissions page.
Registration fee 400 RMB; Insurance 400 RMB/semester

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Nanjing University Postgraduate Program
scholarships.amount_text: Free tuition and insurance plus 3,000 RMB/month for master's students or 3,500 RMB/month for doctoral students.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for master's or doctoral study at NJU who meet academic, age and language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply from January 1 to March 31 via CSC system and NJU Institute for International Students. Contact issd@nju.edu.cn for guidance.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Belt and Road Program
scholarships.amount_text: Free tuition and insurance plus 2,500 RMB/month for bachelor's students and 3,000 RMB/month for master's students.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants from the 64 Belt and Road countries, aged 18-25 for bachelor's with high school education or up to 35 for master's with bachelor's degree, meeting language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply from January 1 to March 31 via CSC system with NJU as target and contact NJU international students office.

scholarships.title: Nanjing Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: 20,000 RMB/year for postgraduate and PhD students; 10,000 RMB/year for undergraduates; 5,000 RMB/semester for non-degree students.
scholarships.eligibility: International students studying at NJU with good academic performance and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply from March 1 to June 15 via NJU Institute for International Students at issd@nju.edu.cn.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Exempt registration fees, tuition, basic materials, on-campus accommodation, plus one-off resettlement subsidy, monthly living allowance, outpatient service and insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens aged 16-35 (teachers in post below 45) with good health and academics, applying for Chinese language advanced study or MTCSOL.
scholarships.instructions: Apply from March to May via cis.chinese.cn and contact Ms. Xu at qzxu@nju.edu.cn for NJU confirmation.

name: Southeast University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: CSC China Scholarship Council Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Full scholarship covering all tuition fees plus monthly allowance up to 3,500 RMB; partial options waive some tuition.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding non-Chinese citizens applying for SEU degree or non-degree study who meet academic and language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via CSC system and SEU online system at fs.seu.edu.cn. SEU nominates most competent students for favorable funding.

scholarships.title: SEU Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver (full or partial) based on assessment.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international applicants for SEU degree programs with strong academics, meeting HSK 4 200+ for Chinese-taught or TOEFL 80 / IELTS 6.0 for English-taught plus other requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on SEU online system at fs.seu.edu.cn from November 22, 2025 to May 15, 2026. Select SEU School Scholarship program and submit materials.

scholarships.title: Jiangsu Provincial Government Jasmine Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students studying at SEU with good academic performance and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Check college latest notice and apply via SEU College of International Students. Selection is once a year.

scholarships.title: Nanjing Municipal Government Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: International students at SEU with good performance. New students contact Admissions Office; second year and above contact International Students Office.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via SEU admissions or international students office, usually June to September. See college notice for exact dates.

name: NJUST
tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught: 18,000 RMB/year
Graduate and English-taught tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.
Application fee: 500 RMB

scholarships.title: NJUST Lanshan Scholarship Program
scholarships.amount_text: Undergraduate A+: tuition and accommodation waived + 1,000 RMB/month; A: tuition waived; B: 50% tuition; C: accommodation waived. Master's Full: tuition and accommodation + 1,500 RMB/month. Doctoral A/B/C: tuition and accommodation + 3,500/2,500/1,500 RMB/month.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students for undergraduate, master's (3 years) or doctoral (4 years) Chinese or English-taught study in NJUST top disciplines. Undergraduates must take CSCA and submit scores.
scholarships.instructions: Apply from November 30, 2025 to May 15, 2026 via NJUST portal at njust.17gz.org. Annual performance evaluation is required to maintain eligibility.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – High-Level Postgraduate Program
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition fully waived, on-campus accommodation or allowance, monthly living stipend and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: International applicants for master's (3 years) or doctoral (4 years) study at NJUST in Chinese or English who are not studying in China and meet academic and language requirements. Agency number 10288.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via both CSC Information System and NJUST platform at admission.njust.edu.cn. Those not awarded CSC may be considered for Lanshan Scholarship.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Silk Road Program
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waived, accommodation, living stipend and medical insurance per CSC policy.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students applying for NJUST degree programs under the Silk Road Program who meet CSC eligibility.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via CSC system and NJUST portal. Follow the 2026 Silk Road admissions guide on study.njust.edu.cn for details.

name: NJUPT
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: NJUPT International Students Scholarship – First-Class General
scholarships.amount_text: Waive the current academic year tuition fee. Second-class: master 15,000 RMB, bachelor 12,000 RMB; Third-class: master 10,000 RMB, bachelor 7,500 RMB.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international bachelor and master students with good conduct, learning attitude and no violations who register and pay fees on time. All freshmen get first-class; enrolled students: 50% first, 30% second, 20% third.
documents: Recommendation letter and papers for graduates
scholarships.instructions: Freshmen apply to Department of International Cooperation by May 31 each year; second year and above apply to College of Overseas Education by September 30. Annual review each October.

scholarships.title: NJUPT Special Scholarship for PhD Students
scholarships.amount_text: First-class PhD general scholarship plus 2,000 RMB/month living allowance; Second-class plus 1,000 RMB/month. Doctor general second 18,000 RMB, third 12,000 RMB.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international doctoral students at NJUPT. 50% get first-class special, 50% second-class for both freshmen and enrolled students.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via international cooperation office with academic achievements. Evaluation group of relevant units decides winners.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Silk Road Program
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for NJUPT degree study under the Silk Road Program who meet academic and language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: See the 2026 Silk Road admission brochure on NJUPT English site and apply via CSC system plus NJUPT portal.

name: Hohai University
tuition_info:
Master's: Chinese-taught 24,000 RMB/year; English-taught 32,000 RMB/year
Doctoral: Chinese-taught 32,000 RMB/year; English-taught 44,000 RMB/year
Application fee: 400 RMB

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – University Program (Type B)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition fees, university dormitory, monthly stipend (master 3,000 RMB/month; doctoral 3,500 RMB/month) and medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens under 35 for master's and under 40 for doctoral, not studying in China, with good academics. Hohai agency number 10294, Type B for postgraduates and doctoral students.
scholarships.instructions: Complete both CSC system and Hohai application at admission.hhu.edu.cn with 400 RMB fee. Professors review and university committee decides.

scholarships.title: Hohai University Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Full: tuition, accommodation, insurance and monthly allowance (master and doctoral only). Partial: one or several items. First-class includes tuition, dorm, insurance and stipend; second includes tuition and dorm; third includes tuition.
scholarships.eligibility: Foreign citizens with valid passport in good health. Under 25 for undergraduate, under 35 for master with bachelor's degree, under 40 for doctoral with master's degree, academically excellent.
scholarships.instructions: Apply online via ie.hhu.edu.cn usually January to May with 400 RMB fee. Dynamic annual review based on academic and comprehensive performance.

scholarships.title: Nanjing Municipal Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: 20,000 RMB/year with annual review.
scholarships.eligibility: International students at Hohai with good performance.
scholarships.instructions: Download the Nanjing Government form, complete and upload on Hohai application system. See annual notice for dates.

scholarships.title: Jasmine Jiangsu Government Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students at Hohai. Individual application is not accepted since 2020; university nominates per provincial policy.
scholarships.instructions: Contact admission@hhu.edu.cn for current Jasmine Scholarship nomination procedure. See Hohai international school notice.

name: NNU
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Nanjing Normal University Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Living allowance 1,000 RMB/month for undergraduates plus insurance 800 RMB/academic year.
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate (English-taught), master's and doctoral international applicants with strong academics. Master's needs HSK 5 180+; doctoral needs HSK 6 180+; English-taught needs TOEFL/IELTS or prior English education proof.
scholarships.instructions: Log in the NNU online application system from March 1 to May 1, 2026 and submit materials. Follow the 2026 application guide for review.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – High Level Postgraduate Program
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for NNU master's or doctoral programs with excellent academics and meeting language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via CSC system and NNU portal per the 2026 High Level guide. NNU reviews and recommends to CSC.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Silk Road Program
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students applying for NNU degree study under the Silk Road Program.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the 2026 Silk Road guide on NNU admissions page and apply via CSC plus NNU systems.

name: HUST
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Chinese University Program (Type B)
scholarships.amount_text: Full scholarship covering tuition waiver, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance for master and doctoral study.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding non-Chinese graduates with GPA 3.0/4 or 75%+. Master under 35 with bachelor's degree; doctoral under 40 with master's degree. English: TOEFL 80+/IELTS 6.0+ or prior English degree; Chinese: HSK 4 180+ science/engineering/medicine or HSK 5 180+ others.
documents: CV and study plan over 1000 words
Language certificate and two recommendation letters
Passport, physical exam and non-criminal record
scholarships.instructions: Apply at admission.hust.edu.cn, pass language test and academic review to get pre-admission letter, then complete CSC system (Type B, agency 10487) and upload non-academic documents. Fee 600 CNY.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Bilateral Program (Type A)
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese applicants for undergraduate, postgraduate and scholar programs applying via dispatching authorities such as Chinese embassy or education department.
scholarships.instructions: Do not apply directly to HUST or CSC; apply to home country dispatching authority and obtain pre-admission letter via admission.hust.edu.cn if required.

scholarships.title: China Link Scholarship Program
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation, medical insurance and stipend (3,000 RMB general scholar; 3,500 RMB senior scholar) for 1-12 months.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens other than PRC in good health who are full-time students or staff at CSC foreign partner universities. General scholar under 45 (undergrad/master); senior scholar under 50 (PhD/faculty). All fields except Chinese language study.
scholarships.instructions: Contact HUST at vivianyan@hust.edu.cn for invitation letter first, then complete CSC system with agency 10487. HUST nominates to CSC in batches.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese Chinese language teachers and students outside China with good health and academics who meet HSK requirements and are recommended.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via scholarship website and HUST portal. See HUST international student office notice for details.

name: Wuhan University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – High Level Graduate Program (Type B)
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health applying for Wuhan University master's or doctoral programs with excellent academics and meeting language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Check the 2026 Type B guide on admission.whu.edu.cn, apply via CSC system and WHU portal, and await expert review.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Bilateral Program (Type A)
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese applicants for undergraduate, graduate or scholar programs applying via receiving agencies such as Chinese embassies, with WHU as target university.
documents: Pre-admission notice from WHU if obtained
scholarships.instructions: Reach WHU for pre-admission document, then apply to receiving agency and fill CSC system. CSC notifies results via agency.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship – Belt and Road Program (Type B 2026)
scholarships.amount_text: Covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding students from Belt and Road countries applying for WHU degree programs who meet CSC and WHU requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the Belt and Road Type B 2026 guide on admission.whu.edu.cn and apply via CSC plus WHU systems.

scholarships.title: China-Link Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: International visiting students and scholars for short-term study or research exchange at WHU.
scholarships.instructions: See the China-Link guide on admission.whu.edu.cn and apply per instructions. Contact sie@whu.edu.cn for help.
